Please be informed however that HB No. 1845 was passed during the 1 h Congress and this Department has no information on its status. Anent the query on whether CVG may be provided with free group insurance coverage, please be advised that based on RA 6942, the provisi n of benefits under the LOIPF only extends to the punong barangay, sangguniang barang y members, barangay secretary, and barangay treasurer, and sangguniang kabataan chair an who do not receive a fixed salary during their incumbency; while duly appointed me bers of the barangay tanod brigades, or their equivalent, which shall number not more tha twenty (20) in each barangay, shall be granted insurance or other benefits during their cumbency chargeable against local funds pending the establishment of an insurance cove age system as provided under Section 393 (d) in relation to Section #25 (a) of the LGC, whi h provides the budgetary limitations on personnel services of LGUs.
